title: Kaldi and the Red Berries

references.description: Fictional young Ethiopian goat herder; use the same face, hair, and simple woven clothing in every Kaldi shot.
Warm natural light, tactile cinematic realism, and compositions that keep important subjects in frame for both exports.

shots.image_prompt: Kaldi addresses the camera on a misty Ethiopian hillside.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push toward Kaldi; hold on his face.

narration.text: ስሜ ካልዲ ነው። በየቀኑ ፍየሎቼን እጠብቅ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: My name is Kaldi. Every day I tended my goats.

shots.image_prompt: Kaldi watches his goats graze along a forest path.

narration.subtitle_en: One day, some of my goats wandered away from the herd.

shots.image_prompt: A goat nibbles ripe red coffee cherries among glossy leaves.
shots.motion_prompt: Rack focus from the goat to the cherries.

narration.subtitle_en: I saw them eating red berries.

shots.image_prompt: Goats hop across a clearing while Kaldi watches in surprise.
shots.motion_prompt: Follow one playful leap, then pan to Kaldi.

narration.subtitle_en: Then they started jumping. I laughed when I saw them.

shots.image_prompt: Kaldi holds one red coffee cherry between his fingers.
shots.motion_prompt: Push in gently as Kaldi studies the cherry.

narration.text: ይህ ትንሽ ፍሬ ምን ይሆን ብዬ አሰብኩ።
narration.subtitle_en: I wondered what this little berry could be.

shots.image_prompt: Full-body view of Kaldi on the same hillside, grinning with the red coffee cherry held safely in his hand.
shots.motion_prompt: Kaldi makes one small joyful hop, echoing his goats. Hold wide through the landing, then cut to a close-up of the cherry in his hand for the transition to the roasting beans.

shots.image_prompt: In the present day, hands stir coffee beans in a roasting pan.
shots.motion_prompt: Cut on the round shape of the cherry to a close-up of the beans.

narration.subtitle_en: Today, the smell of coffee still brings people together.

shots.image_prompt: Coffee pours from a jebena into small cups as guests gather.
shots.motion_prompt: Tilt down with the stream of coffee.

shots.image_prompt: Friends and family smile around the coffee ceremony and sing together.
shots.motion_prompt: Pull back from the cups to reveal the gathering.

shots.image_prompt: Dark background for titles added during assembly.

music_cues.prompt: Original understated instrumental score, curious and playful; keep clear of the narration.
Bring in a joyful original group refrain singing ቡና፣ ቡና after Kaldi's last line.

end_card: Inspired by the legend of Kaldi · Made with AI
